description: Recorded run setup and summarized results; historical paths identify original artifacts.

record.objective: Implement three candidates sequentially; benchmark each and retain only notable improvements without major tradeoffs.

candidate_1.reason: No notable improvement: median throughput changes -1.1% to +1.7%, CPU/request reductions 0.2% to 2.3%, RSS increased 1% to 3.1%; remote failures remain variable.
candidate_1.restoration: All baseline source/test hashes match after restoring only the two candidate files.

candidate_2.reason: Two/four-worker loopback throughput improved 5.2%-7.0%, multi-worker CPU/request improved 5.1%-7.9%, unchanged RSS and zero local failures. Remote throughput changes -1.9% to +0.4%, CPU/request improved 1.6%-5.0%, no material memory/latency regression.

candidate_3.reason: With 256 live uploads multi-worker RSS fell 26.8%-33.6% and charged HTTP/2 memory fell 43.5%; six uploads now fit a 1 MiB budget. No large observed tradeoff; one-worker post-burst RSS +6.1%. Timing remains provisional during user-reported CPU noise.

limitations.cpu_noise: Timing collected within the user-reported 30-minute CPU-noise window.

record.acceptance_guide: Repeated multi-worker >=5% throughput/CPU or >=10% memory improvement; inspect latency, failures, memory and CPU regressions rather than trusting one metric or trial.

candidate_3_design.storage: Keep a small stream with inline common header/path/output scratch and field references; grow owned header/trailer buffers within existing limits; allocate application storage before init and producer storage before streaming. Preserve cached owned allocations across stream reuse.
candidate_3_design.ownership: Header-buffer growth must rebase pseudo-header and ordinary header slices before dispatch; trailer growth must never relocate request headers while hooks run. Request/app/body/output borrows remain stable until executor and framing completion.
candidate_3_design.regression: Demonstrate six concurrent small POST streams complete with real bodies under a 1 MiB worker HTTP/2 budget after lazy storage, fail before; retain exhaustion/recovery and add header/trailer/cookie growth coverage.

noise_notice.source: User reports CPU noise on benchmark server
noise_notice.policy: Storage timing in this window is provisional; assess memory and correctness, repeat decision-sensitive throughput/CPU comparisons after noise window.

candidate_3_capacity.timing: Fixed live population, no request-rate claim
